text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several declines, so short-term losses alone are not a reason to react; I should stay aligned with a considered plan.","Selling Stock D at a gain felt good, but that feeling is not evidence that selling was the right decision; I should weigh each trade against my goals.","Because losses sting and admitting a mistake is hard, I should check that those feelings—not just the investment case—aren’t keeping me from making a sound decision."]}
